# All effects are character scope (the ruler).

aov_invention_box_of_holding_discover = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_box_of_holding value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_last_discovered value = flag:box_of_holding }
}
aov_invention_box_of_holding_activate = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_activation_counter } } set_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_box_of_holding value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_box_of_holding_order value = var:aov_inv_activation_counter }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_artificery_dormant } NOT = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_box_of_holding } }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_box_of_holding }
	}
}
aov_invention_box_of_holding_deactivate = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_box_of_holding value = 1 }
	remove_variable = aov_inv_box_of_holding_order
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_box_of_holding } remove_character_modifier = aov_invention_box_of_holding }
}

	change_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_clockwork_orrery value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_clockwork_orrery_order value = var:aov_inv_activation_counter }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_artificery_dormant } NOT = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_clockwork_orrery } }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_clockwork_orrery }
	}
}
aov_invention_clockwork_orrery_deactivate = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_clockwork_orrery value = 1 }
	remove_variable = aov_inv_clockwork_orrery_order
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_clockwork_orrery } remove_character_modifier = aov_invention_clockwork_orrery }
}

# Technomancers: roll up to 3 economic offers for this research cycle
aov_inventions_roll_offers_economic = {
	remove_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_1
	remove_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_2
	remove_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_3
	set_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_economic
	if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_economic_unoffered_discoverable = yes }
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_discoverable = yes NOT = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_offered = yes } }
				set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_economic_1 value = flag:box_of_holding }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_discoverable = yes NOT = { aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_offered = yes } }
				set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_economic_1 value = flag:clockwork_abacus }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_discoverable = yes NOT = { aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_offered = yes } }

# AI: start Technomancer research on one of the rolled economic offers
aov_inventions_ai_start_technomancers_economic = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_offered = yes aov_invention_box_of_holding_discoverable = yes }
			aov_artificery_start_technomancers_research = { CATEGORY = economic TARGET = box_of_holding }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_offered = yes aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_discoverable = yes }

# AI: start Technomancer research on one of the rolled society offers
aov_inventions_ai_start_technomancers_society = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = { aov_invention_centipedal_chests_offered = yes aov_invention_centipedal_chests_discoverable = yes }
			aov_artificery_start_technomancers_research = { CATEGORY = society TARGET = centipedal_chests }
		}
		1 = {

# Technomancers: discover the chosen target if it is still discoverable
aov_inventions_discover_research_target = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:box_of_holding aov_invention_box_of_holding_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_box_of_holding_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:clockwork_abacus aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:clockwork_waterwheels aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_discoverable = yes }

		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:growth_beans aov_invention_growth_beans_discoverable = yes }

		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:self_cleaning_parchment aov_invention_self_cleaning_parchment_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_self_cleaning_parchment_discover = yes
	}

# Discovery event option: activate what was just discovered
aov_inventions_activate_last_discovered = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:box_of_holding aov_invention_box_of_holding_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_box_of_holding_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:clockwork_abacus aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:clockwork_waterwheels aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:growth_beans aov_invention_growth_beans_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_growth_beans_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:self_cleaning_parchment aov_invention_self_cleaning_parchment_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_self_cleaning_parchment_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:alchemical_distilleries aov_invention_alchemical_distilleries_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_alchemical_distilleries_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:arithmatons aov_invention_arithmatons_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_arithmatons_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:damestear_lamps aov_invention_damestear_lamps_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_damestear_lamps_activate = yes

# Over the slot maximum: deactivate the most recently activated invention (no cooldown)
aov_inventions_deactivate_newest = {
	if = {
		limit = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_active = yes has_variable = aov_inv_box_of_holding_order var:aov_inv_box_of_holding_order = aov_invention_newest_order }
		aov_invention_box_of_holding_deactivate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_active = yes has_variable = aov_inv_clockwork_abacus_order var:aov_inv_clockwork_abacus_order = aov_invention_newest_order }

# Heir scope; scope:aov_predecessor is the dead ruler. Union of discoveries; their active inventions become active.
aov_inventions_inherit = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_active = yes } NOT = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_active = yes } }
		aov_invention_box_of_holding_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_inv_box_of_holding } NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_box_of_holding } }
		set_variable = { name = aov_inv_box_of_holding value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_active = yes } NOT = { aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_active = yes } }
		aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_inv_clockwork_abacus } NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_clockwork_abacus } }
		set_variable = { name = aov_inv_clockwork_abacus value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_active = yes } NOT = { aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_active = yes } }
		aov_invention_clockwork_waterwheels_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_inv_clockwork_waterwheels } NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_clockwork_waterwheels } }

	}

# AI: activate the highest-tier discovered invention
aov_inventions_ai_activate_best = {
	if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_t3_activatable = yes }
		aov_inventions_ai_activate_tier_3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_t2_activatable = yes }
		aov_inventions_ai_activate_tier_2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_t1_activatable = yes }
		aov_inventions_ai_activate_tier_1 = yes
	}
}

# AI: tier 1, Military at war, Economic at peace, otherwise any
aov_inventions_ai_activate_tier_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_at_war = yes aov_inventions_t1_military_activatable = yes }
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_ancestral_golems_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_ancestral_golems_activate = yes
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_brass_cuirasses_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_brass_cuirasses_activate = yes
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_clockwork_ballistae_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_clockwork_ballistae_activate = yes
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_clockwork_repeaters_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_clockwork_repeaters_activate = yes
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_damestear_powder_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_damestear_powder_activate = yes
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_sunbeam_armaments_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_sunbeam_armaments_activate = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_at_war = no aov_inventions_t1_economic_activatable = yes }
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_box_of_holding_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_box_of_holding_activate = yes
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_activatable = yes }
				aov_invention_clockwork_abacus_activate = yes
			}
			1 = {
